law_name: Act on Data Protection and the Processing of Personal Data (Act No. 90/2018)
key_requirements: Implements GDPR via EEA Agreement, lawful basis and data subject rights, supervision
deceased_data: Statutory rule not confirmed; Supreme Court (constitutional privacy) lets close relatives oppose use of a deceased person's identifiable medical data for genetic research (unconfirmed)
research_exemption: Restrictions of data subject rights for research and public-interest purposes; prior authorisation for some sensitive-data research outside the Act on Scientific Research in the Health Sector (articles not confirmed) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Special category under art. 9 GDPR; DPA required consent for genetic studies (deCODE estimated genotypes); Biobanks Act 110/2000 also applies (unconfirmed)
notes: Replaced Act 77/2000; GDPR applies through EEA Agreement Annex XI
